description: This file contains helper functions and declarations for ASN.1 RRC configuration related to 5G NR, including functions to create ASN.1 structures from internal configs, and functions to compute configuration differences for handover and measurement gap configurations.

methods.name: get_asn1_scs
methods.description: Converts a subcarrier_spacing enum to its ASN.1 representation.

methods.name: make_asn1_rrc_coreset
methods.description: Creates ASN.1 coreset structure from configuration.

methods.name: make_asn1_rrc_search_space
methods.description: Creates ASN.1 search space structure from configuration.

methods.name: make_asn1_rrc_scs_specific_carrier_list
methods.description: Creates ASN.1 list of specific carriers from a span of carriers.

methods.name: make_asn1_init_dl_bwp
methods.description: Creates ASN.1 downlink BWP structure from configuration.

methods.name: make_asn1_rrc_initial_up_bwp
methods.description: Creates ASN.1 uplink BWP structure from configuration.

methods.name: make_asn1_rrc_tdd_ul_dl_cfg_common
methods.description: Creates ASN.1 TDD UL/DL configuration structure.

methods.name: make_asn1_rrc_pusch_pathloss_ref_rs
methods.description: Creates ASN.1 PUSCH pathloss reference resource.

methods.name: make_asn1_rrc_sri_pusch_pwr_ctrl
methods.description: Creates ASN.1 SRI PUSCH power control structure.

methods.name: calculate_cell_group_config_diff
methods.description: Fills ASN.1 CellGroupConfig struct based on previous and next UE configurations.

methods.name: calculate_reconfig_with_sync_diff
methods.description: Computes ReconfigurationWithSync ASN.1 field for handover scenarios.

methods.name: calculate_meas_gap_config_diff
methods.description: Fills ASN.1 measGapConfig struct based on UE configuration changes.
